A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 95-page versions of the same survey. Text, equations, figures and tables can be matched throughout. Both end with references and contain no separate appendix.

before.justification: Section 6.4 reports the survey's own descriptive analysis of cited mathematical and code-reasoning studies: approximately two-thirds emphasize pass@1 improvements, while one-third report expanded pass@k frontiers. This constitutes original analysis of literature data.

after.justification: Section 6.4 retains the authors' descriptive analysis of the surveyed studies, including the approximate two-thirds/one-third proportions and associated qualitative findings. These original data-analysis results remain present in v5.

M1.justification: The RL algorithms and agent architectures described in Sections 2.7–4 are unchanged. No algorithmic component, objective or procedural adaptation is introduced or revised.

E1.justification: The studies underlying Section 6.4's analysis and the task, dataset and environment coverage in Sections 4–5 are unchanged. No new training or evaluation scenario is reported.

E2.justification: The methods included in the benchmark comparisons in Figures 7–8 and the comparative survey tables are unchanged. No comparison method is added, removed or revised.

E3.justification: The versions report identical evaluation metrics and experimental settings. No evaluation protocol or condition attached to the surveyed results is revised.

E4.justification: The mathematical-reasoning case study in Section 6.4 is retained verbatim. No ablation, robustness test, sensitivity analysis or other supplementary analysis is added or altered.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including Section 6.4's approximate study proportions. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation or significance-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: The performance plots in Figures 7–8 are identical, and Section 6.4 retains the same approximate two-thirds/one-third finding. No numerical value, result entry or qualitative finding changes.

T1.justification: Section 2's mathematical definitions, assumptions, MDP/POMDP formalization and objective equations are identical. No mathematical result, derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statement and conclusion retain the same claims about formalizing Agentic RL, providing a capability/application taxonomy and consolidating research resources.

C2.justification: Section 6 retains the same mechanism debate, mathematical-reasoning interpretation, applicability conditions and open challenges. No substantive explanation or limitation changes.

D1.justification: Technical descriptions and code/resource access information are unchanged, including the method, environment and framework tables. Their external resource-link targets also remain the same.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, research positioning and complete reference list are unchanged.

P1.justification: Mengyue Yang's affiliation changes from Dalian University of Technology to the newly listed University of Bristol. The arXiv version/date stamp and self-link are updated. Substantive prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The additional affiliation line causes text reflow and altered page breaks on pages 1–4. Figures and tables retain their content, design and placement; pages 5–95 render identically.

improvement.justification: The revision updates an author affiliation and version information, with minor opening-page reflow. The scientific content, quantitative synthesis, supporting material and resource information are unchanged, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
